<script type="text/x-handlebars-template-logic">
(function() {
  function normalizeCharacter(char) {
    if (!char || typeof char !== "object") return char;

    var s = char.stats;
    if (!s || typeof s !== "object") {
      s = char;
      char.stats = s;
    }

    // 1. Role / Title (Header)
    var role = char.role || s.role || char.title || s.title;
    if (!role) {
      var cls = char["class"] || s["class"];
      var lvl = char.level || s.level;
      if (cls) {
        role = lvl ? (cls + " • Level " + lvl) : String(cls);
      } else if (lvl) {
        role = "Level " + lvl;
      } else {
        role = "Character";
      }
    }
    s.role = role;
    char.role = role;

    // 2. HP (Numeric vs Text)
    var rawHp = s.hp || char.hp;
    var hpObj = { current: "Healthy", max: "Healthy", isNumeric: false, pct: 0, display: "Healthy" };
    if (typeof rawHp === "number" || typeof rawHp === "string") {
      hpObj.current = rawHp;
      hpObj.max = rawHp;
    } else if (rawHp && typeof rawHp === "object") {
      hpObj.current = rawHp.current !== undefined ? rawHp.current : "Healthy";
      hpObj.max = rawHp.max !== undefined ? rawHp.max : hpObj.current;
    }

    var numCur = Number(hpObj.current);
    var numMax = Number(hpObj.max);
    var isCurNum = typeof hpObj.current === "number" || (!isNaN(numCur) && String(hpObj.current).trim() !== "");
    var isMaxNum = typeof hpObj.max === "number" || (!isNaN(numMax) && String(hpObj.max).trim() !== "");

    if (isCurNum && isMaxNum && numMax > 0) {
      hpObj.isNumeric = true;
      hpObj.current = numCur;
      hpObj.max = numMax;
      hpObj.pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((numCur / numMax) * 100)));
      hpObj.display = numCur + " / " + numMax + " HP";
    } else {
      hpObj.isNumeric = false;
      var cStr = String(hpObj.current !== undefined && hpObj.current !== null ? hpObj.current : "");
      var mStr = String(hpObj.max !== undefined && hpObj.max !== null ? hpObj.max : "");
      if (cStr && mStr && cStr !== mStr) {
        hpObj.display = cStr + " / " + mStr;
      } else {
        hpObj.display = cStr || mStr || "Unknown";
      }
    }
    s.hp = hpObj;

    // 3. Resources (Arbitrary name & non-numeric support)
    var rawRes = s.resources || char.resources;
    var resObj = { name: "Mana", current: "Normal", max: "Normal", display: "Mana" };
    if (rawRes && typeof rawRes === "object") {
      resObj.name = rawRes.name || "Mana";
      resObj.current = rawRes.current !== undefined ? rawRes.current : "Normal";
      resObj.max = rawRes.max !== undefined ? rawRes.max : resObj.current;
    } else if (typeof rawRes === "string" || typeof rawRes === "number") {
      resObj.current = rawRes;
      resObj.max = rawRes;
    }

    var rCur = String(resObj.current !== undefined && resObj.current !== null ? resObj.current : "");
    var rMax = String(resObj.max !== undefined && resObj.max !== null ? resObj.max : "");
    if (rCur === rMax || !rMax) {
      resObj.display = rCur ? (rCur + " " + resObj.name) : resObj.name;
    } else {
      resObj.display = rCur + " / " + rMax + " " + resObj.name;
    }
    s.resources = resObj;

    // 4. Combat State
    var rawCombat = s.combat || char.combat || {};
    s.combat = {
      target: rawCombat.target || "None",
      stance: rawCombat.stance || "Neutral"
    };

    // 5. Buffs
    var rawBuffs = rawCombat.buffs || s.buffs || char.buffs || [];
    var buffList = [];
    if (Array.isArray(rawBuffs)) {
      for (var i = 0; i < rawBuffs.length; i++) {
        var b = rawBuffs[i];
        if (typeof b === "string") {
          buffList.push({ name: b, origin: "Self", type: "pos" });
        } else if (b && typeof b === "object") {
          buffList.push({
            name: b.name || "Effect",
            origin: b.origin || "",
            type: b.type === "neg" ? "neg" : "pos"
          });
        }
      }
    } else if (typeof rawBuffs === "string") {
      var parts = rawBuffs.split(",");
      for (var j = 0; j < parts.length; j++) {
        var p = parts[j].trim();
        if (p) buffList.push({ name: p, origin: "Self", type: "pos" });
      }
    }
    s.combat.buffs = buffList;

    // 6. Abilities / Authorities / Spirit Arts
    var rawAbil = s.abilities || char.abilities;
    var abilList = [];
    if (Array.isArray(rawAbil)) {
      for (var k = 0; k < rawAbil.length; k++) {
        var a = rawAbil[k];
        if (typeof a === "string") {
          abilList.push({ name: a, cost: "", status: "Ready" });
        } else if (a && typeof a === "object") {
          abilList.push({
            name: a.name || "Ability",
            cost: a.cost || "",
            status: a.status || "Ready"
          });
        }
      }
    } else if (typeof rawAbil === "string") {
      var aParts = rawAbil.split(",");
      for (var l = 0; l < aParts.length; l++) {
        var ap = aParts[l].trim();
        if (ap) abilList.push({ name: ap, cost: "", status: "Ready" });
      }
    }
    s.abilities = abilList;

    // 7. Inventory / Possessions
    var rawInv = s.inventory || char.inventory;
    var invList = [];
    if (Array.isArray(rawInv)) {
      for (var m = 0; m < rawInv.length; m++) {
        var item = rawInv[m];
        if (typeof item === "string") {
          invList.push({ name: item, qty: 1, icon: "📦" });
        } else if (item && typeof item === "object") {
          invList.push({
            name: item.name || "Item",
            qty: item.qty !== undefined ? item.qty : 1,
            icon: item.icon || "📦"
          });
        }
      }
    } else if (typeof rawInv === "string") {
      var iParts = rawInv.split(",");
      for (var n = 0; n < iParts.length; n++) {
        var ip = iParts[n].trim();
        if (ip) invList.push({ name: ip, qty: 1, icon: "📦" });
      }
    }
    s.inventory = invList;

    // 8. Relationships / Bonds
    var rawRel = s.relationships || char.relationships;
    var relList = [];
    if (Array.isArray(rawRel)) {
      for (var rIdx = 0; rIdx < rawRel.length; rIdx++) {
        var rItem = rawRel[rIdx];
        if (typeof rItem === "string") {
          relList.push({ name: rItem, affection: 0, desire: 0, trust: 0, contempt: 0 });
        } else if (rItem && typeof rItem === "object") {
          relList.push({
            name: rItem.name || "Target",
            affection: rItem.affection !== undefined ? Number(rItem.affection) || 0 : 0,
            desire: rItem.desire !== undefined ? Number(rItem.desire) || 0 : 0,
            trust: rItem.trust !== undefined ? Number(rItem.trust) || 0 : 0,
            contempt: rItem.contempt !== undefined ? Number(rItem.contempt) || 0 : 0
          });
        }
      }
    } else if (rawRel && typeof rawRel === "object") {
      var relKeys = Object.keys(rawRel);
      var hasDirectStatKey = relKeys.some(function(k) {
        return ["affection", "desire", "trust", "contempt"].indexOf(k) !== -1;
      });
      var isOldFormat = hasDirectStatKey && typeof rawRel[relKeys.find(function(k) {
        return ["affection", "desire", "trust", "contempt"].indexOf(k) !== -1;
      })] !== "object";

      if (isOldFormat) {
        relList.push({
          name: s.relationshipTarget || char.relationshipTarget || "",
          affection: rawRel.affection !== undefined ? Number(rawRel.affection) || 0 : 0,
          desire: rawRel.desire !== undefined ? Number(rawRel.desire) || 0 : 0,
          trust: rawRel.trust !== undefined ? Number(rawRel.trust) || 0 : 0,
          contempt: rawRel.contempt !== undefined ? Number(rawRel.contempt) || 0 : 0
        });
      } else {
        for (var rKey in rawRel) {
          if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rawRel, rKey)) {
            var val = rawRel[rKey];
            if (val && typeof val === "object") {
              relList.push({
                name: rKey,
                affection: val.affection !== undefined ? Number(val.affection) || 0 : 0,
                desire: val.desire !== undefined ? Number(val.desire) || 0 : 0,
                trust: val.trust !== undefined ? Number(val.trust) || 0 : 0,
                contempt: val.contempt !== undefined ? Number(val.contempt) || 0 : 0
              });
            } else if (typeof val === "number" || typeof val === "string") {
              relList.push({
                name: rKey,
                affection: Number(val) || 0,
                desire: 0,
                trust: 0,
                contempt: 0
              });
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    s.relationshipList = relList;
    s.relationships = relList;

    return char;
  }

  if (data && typeof data === "object") {
    if (Array.isArray(data.characters)) {
      for (var c = 0; c < data.characters.length; c++) {
        normalizeCharacter(data.characters[c]);
      }
    } else {
      normalizeCharacter(data);
    }
  }
})();
</script>

<style>
    /* =========================================
       1. CORE VARIABLES & THEME (Re:Zero Palette)
       ========================================= */
    .sim-tracker-container {
        --sst-font-stack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
        --sst-bg-deep: #08060c;

        /* Glass System - Re:Zero Dark Violet Glass */
        --sst-glass-panel: rgba(18, 14, 26, 0.94);
        --sst-glass-sidebar: rgba(12, 9, 18, 0.88);
        --sst-glass-border: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.18);
        --sst-blur-amt: 40px;

        /* Colors */
        --sst-txt-main: #e2e8f0;
        --sst-txt-muted: #94a3b8;
        --sst-txt-accent: #f8fafc;

        /* RPG Colors */
        --sst-hp-col: #ef4444;
        --sst-mp-col: #38bdf8;
        --sst-stam-col: #10b981;
        --sst-cd-col: #f43f5e;

        /* Buffs/Debuffs */
        --sst-buff-pos: #34d399;
        --sst-buff-neg: #c084fc;

        /* Gradients for Relationship Matrix */
        --sst-grad-aff: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff9a9e 0%, #fbc2eb 100%);
        --sst-grad-des: linear-gradient(90deg, #f5576c 0%, #f093fb 100%);
        --sst-grad-tru: linear-gradient(90deg, #38f9d7 0%, #43e97b 100%);
        --sst-grad-con: linear-gradient(90deg, #a8a8a8 0%, #64748b 100%);
    }

    .sim-tracker-container, .sim-tracker-container * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    /* =========================================
       2. LAYOUT
       ========================================= */
    .sim-tracker-container {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        grid-template-rows: 1fr;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        position: relative;
        pointer-events: none !important;
        font-family: var(--sst-font-stack);
        color: var(--sst-txt-main);
    }

    .sim-tracker-tabs,
    .sim-tracker-cards-wrapper {
        grid-column: 1;
        grid-row: 1;
        position: relative;
        height: 100%;
        width: 100%;
        pointer-events: none !important;
    }

    .sim-tracker-container svg { display: block; }

    /* =========================================
       3. TABS
       ========================================= */
    .sim-tracker-tabs {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        align-items: flex-end;
        padding: 24px 8px 24px 0;
        z-index: 2;
    }

    .sim-tracker-tab {
        width: 52px; height: 52px;
        position: relative;
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: var(--sst-glass-sidebar);
        backdrop-filter: blur(var(--sst-blur-amt));
        border: 1px solid var(--sst-glass-border);
        cursor: pointer;
        display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700;
        color: #aaa;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        pointer-events: auto !important;
        box-shadow: -5px 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        z-index: 3;
    }

    .sim-tracker-tab:hover { background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2); transform: scale(1.05); color: #fff; border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4); }

    .sim-tracker-tab.active {
        background: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.25); border-color: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.6);
        color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.4);
    }

    .signal { position: absolute; bottom: -2px; right: -2px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #101015; }
    .sig-danger { background: var(--sst-hp-col); }
    .sig-ok { background: var(--sst-stam-col); }

    /* =========================================
       4. CARDS
       ========================================= */
    .sim-tracker-cards-wrapper {
        display: flex;
        align-items: stretch;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        z-index: 1;
    }

    .sim-tracker-card {
        position: absolute !important;
        right: 0 !important;
        top: 0; bottom: 0;
        width: 320px;
        max-width: 100%;
        background: var(--sst-glass-panel);
        border-left: 1px solid var(--sst-glass-border);
        border-radius: 14px 0 0 14px;
        backdrop-filter: blur(40px);
        display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
        padding: 24px 18px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overflow-x: hidden;

        /* Animation States */
        transform: translateX(105%);
        opacity: 0;
        visibility: hidden;
        transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), opacity 0.4s ease, visibility 0.4s;
        pointer-events: auto !important;

        /* Hide scrollbars */
        scrollbar-width: none;
        -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }

    .sim-tracker-card::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 0; height: 0; display: none; }

    .sim-tracker-card.active {
        transform: translateX(0);
        opacity: 1;
        visibility: visible;
    }

    .sim-tracker-card.sliding-out {
        transform: translateX(50%);
        opacity: 0;
        visibility: hidden;
    }

    /* =========================================
       5. WIDGETS & MODULES
       ========================================= */
    .widget {
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
        border: 1px solid var(--sst-glass-border);
        border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px;
        display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .w-header {
        font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
        color: var(--sst-txt-muted); font-weight: 700; display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
    }

    /* --- HEADER --- */
    .header-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .av-lg {
        width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.15);
        border: 2px solid rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.3); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        font-size: 1.7rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); flex-shrink: 0; color: #fff;
    }
    .char-name { min-width: 0; }
    .char-name h1 { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; line-height: 1.1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .char-role { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #c084fc; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 4px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

    /* --- VITALS & STATE --- */
    .hp-numeric { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .hp-numeric span { color: var(--sst-txt-muted); font-size: 0.75rem; }

    .bar-track { width: 100%; height: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
    .bar-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--sst-hp-col); width: var(--pct); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--sst-hp-col); transition: width 0.3s ease; }

    .hp-text-badge {
        background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
        border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 8px 12px;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #f1f5f9;
        text-align: center;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    /* Target & Stance */
    .combat-card {
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px;
        display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
        border-left: 3px solid #c084fc;
        gap: 8px;
    }
    .target-info { min-width: 0; }
    .target-info span { font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: #888; display: block; }
    .target-info b { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #fff; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; display: block; }
    .stance-badge {
        font-size: 0.6rem; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); flex-shrink: 0; color: #e2e8f0;
    }
    /* Buffs Row */
    .buff-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .buff-pill {
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 8px;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        font-size: 0.7rem; cursor: help; position: relative;
    }
    .buff-pill.pos { color: var(--sst-buff-pos); border-color: rgba(52,211,153,0.25); }
    .buff-pill.neg { color: var(--sst-buff-neg); border-color: rgba(192,132,252,0.25); }

    /* --- ABILITIES / SPIRIT ARTS --- */
    .spell-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-height: 180px; overflow-y: auto; padding-right: 2px; }
    .spell-row {
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    }
    .spell-icon { width: 30px; height: 30px; background: rgba(168,85,247,0.1); border-radius: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.9rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .spell-details { flex-grow: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .spell-name { font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; color: #ddd; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .spell-cost { font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--sst-mp-col); }

    .spell-status { font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .st-rdy { color: var(--sst-stam-col); background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12); }
    .st-cd { color: var(--sst-cd-col); background: rgba(244,63,94,0.12); }

    /* --- BONDS / RELATIONSHIP CARDS --- */
    .bonds-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; max-height: 240px; overflow-y: auto; padding-right: 2px; }
    .bond-card {
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        border-radius: 10px;
        padding: 10px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 6px;
    }
    .bond-name {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #fff;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        padding-bottom: 4px;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }
    .rel-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
    .stat-line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr 34px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .stat-icon-text { font-size: 0.8rem; text-align: center; display: inline-block; }
    .stat-track { height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 4px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
    .stat-fill { position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width: 100%; height: 100%; clip-path: inset(0 calc(100% - var(--v)) 0 0); transition: clip-path 0.5s ease; }
    .gf-1 { background: var(--sst-grad-aff); } .gf-2 { background: var(--sst-grad-des); }
    .gf-3 { background: var(--sst-grad-tru); } .gf-4 { background: var(--sst-grad-con); }
    .stat-pct { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; color: #cbd5e1; text-align: right; }

    /* --- POSSESSIONS / INVENTORY --- */
    .inv-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
    .inv-slot {
        aspect-ratio: 1; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
        border-radius: 8px; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
    .inv-slot.filled { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border-color: rgba(168,85,247,0.2); cursor: help; }
    .inv-qty { position: absolute; bottom: 2px; right: 2px; font-size: 0.58rem; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000; font-weight: 700; }
</style>

<div class="sim-tracker-container">

    <!-- TABS -->
    <div class="sim-tracker-tabs">
        {{#each characters}}
        <div class="sim-tracker-tab" data-character="{{@index}}">
            {{initials name}}
            <div class="signal {{#if (and stats.hp.isNumeric (lt stats.hp.pct 25))}}sig-danger{{else}}sig-ok{{/if}}"></div>
        </div>
        {{/each}}
    </div>

    <!-- CARDS -->
    <div class="sim-tracker-cards-wrapper">
    {{#each characters}}
    <div class="sim-tracker-card" data-character="{{@index}}">

        <!-- 1. IDENTITY HEADER -->
        <div class="header-row">
            <div class="av-lg">{{initials name}}</div>
            <div class="char-name">
                <h1>{{name}}</h1>
                <div class="char-role">{{stats.role}}</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 2. CURRENT STATE -->
        <div class="widget">
            <div class="w-header"><span>Current State</span></div>

            <!-- Health Status -->
            <div>
                {{#if stats.hp.isNumeric}}
                <div class="hp-numeric">{{stats.hp.current}} / {{stats.hp.max}} <span>HP</span></div>
                <div class="bar-track">
                    <div class="bar-fill" style="--pct: {{stats.hp.pct}}%"></div>
                </div>
                {{else}}
                <div class="hp-text-badge">{{stats.hp.display}}</div>
                {{/if}}
            </div>

            <!-- Target & Stance -->
            <div class="combat-card">
                <div class="target-info">
                    <span>Targeting</span>
                    <b style="color:#c084fc">{{stats.combat.target}}</b>
                </div>
                <div class="stance-badge">{{stats.combat.stance}}</div>
            </div>

            <!-- Buffs -->
            {{#if stats.combat.buffs.length}}
            <div class="buff-row">
                {{#each stats.combat.buffs}}
                <div class="buff-pill {{type}}" title="{{#if origin}}Source: {{origin}}{{/if}}">{{name}}</div>
                {{/each}}
            </div>
            {{/if}}
        </div>

        <!-- 3. AUTHORITIES / SPIRIT ARTS -->
        <div class="widget">
            <div class="w-header">
                <span>Authorities / Spirit Arts</span>
                <span>{{stats.resources.display}}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="spell-list">
                {{#each stats.abilities}}
                <div class="spell-row">
                    <div class="spell-icon">🔮</div>
                    <div class="spell-details">
                        <div class="spell-name">{{name}}</div>
                        {{#if cost}}<div class="spell-cost">{{cost}}</div>{{/if}}
                    </div>
                    {{#if status}}<div class="spell-status {{#if (eq status 'Ready')}}st-rdy{{else}}st-cd{{/if}}">{{status}}</div>{{/if}}
                </div>
                {{/each}}
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 4. BONDS -->
        <div class="widget">
            <div class="w-header"><span>Bonds</span></div>
            <div class="bonds-list">
                {{#each stats.relationshipList}}
                <div class="bond-card">
                    {{#if name}}<div class="bond-name">{{name}}</div>{{/if}}
                    <div class="rel-grid">
                        <div class="stat-line" title="Affection: {{affection}}%">
                            <span class="stat-icon-text" style="color:#ff9a9e">❤</span>
                            <div class="stat-track"><div class="stat-fill gf-1" style="--v: {{affection}}%"></div></div>
                            <div class="stat-pct">{{affection}}%</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="stat-line" title="Desire: {{desire}}%">
                            <span class="stat-icon-text" style="color:#f5576c">🔥</span>
                            <div class="stat-track"><div class="stat-fill gf-2" style="--v: {{desire}}%"></div></div>
                            <div class="stat-pct">{{desire}}%</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="stat-line" title="Trust: {{trust}}%">
                            <span class="stat-icon-text" style="color:#38f9d7">🛡</span>
                            <div class="stat-track"><div class="stat-fill gf-3" style="--v: {{trust}}%"></div></div>
                            <div class="stat-pct">{{trust}}%</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="stat-line" title="Contempt: {{contempt}}%">
                            <span class="stat-icon-text" style="color:#a8a8a8">☠</span>
                            <div class="stat-track"><div class="stat-fill gf-4" style="--v: {{contempt}}%"></div></div>
                            <div class="stat-pct">{{contempt}}%</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                {{/each}}
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 5. POSSESSIONS -->
        <div class="widget">
            <div class="w-header"><span>Possessions</span></div>
            <div class="inv-grid">
                {{#each stats.inventory}}
                <div class="inv-slot filled" title="{{name}} (x{{qty}})">
                    <span class="inv-icon">{{icon}}</span>
                    <span class="inv-qty">x{{qty}}</span>
                </div>
                {{/each}}
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>
    {{/each}}
    </div>

</div>
<!-- CARD_TEMPLATE_END -->

Authorities, Spirit Arts, or unique abilities
Bonds and character relationships dictionary or list

trackerDesc: Re:Zero style RPG tracker with character states, Authorities/Spirit Arts, Bonds, and Possessions.
